title: Lending decision
question: Can application data support risk-based pricing?
decision: Estimate charge-off probability separately from policy and price.
consequence: Sets PD as the ML quantity.

title: Data and selection
question: Which loans and fields can support the decision?
decision: Load 64 named fields and filter resolved statuses.
uncertainty: Missing raw-field audit and source timing.

title: EDA
question: Does risk or missingness change with issue year?
decision: Use chronological evaluation and numeric missingness indicators.

title: Features
question: Does history or burden show a risk pattern?
decision: Add midpoint FICO, history years and loan-to-income.

title: Experimental design
question: Can training transfer through time?
decision: Oldest 70% training, next 15% validation, newest 15% test.

title: Baselines
question: How much do FICO, application information and LC pricing explain?
decision: Fit logistic reference models on training.
consequence: Defines minimum complexity and incumbent references.

title: Comparisons
question: Are improvements demonstrated?
decision: Use paired test AUC bootstrap differences.
uncertainty: Some comparisons change model and fields.

title: Calibration
question: Are raw probabilities suitable for loss calculations?

title: Thresholds
question: How many defaults can a review flag catch?
uncertainty: Recall falls below target on test.

title: Pricing
question: What severity and rate follow from PD?
decision: Measure training net LGD and assume funding/margin.
consequence: Illustrative expected loss and rate back-test.

title: Artifact export
question: Can the model be invoked consistently?
consequence: Frozen artifact with hashes and 124 transformed columns.
uncertainty: Version-sensitive; original training runtime not locked.

title: Serving
question: What does the browser actually supply?
decision: Validate 15 inputs, derive LTI, fill 40 defaults.
uncertainty: Full-feature metrics do not validate reduced form.

title: Audit
question: Can frozen metrics be reconstructed?
decision: Reconstruct sampling and score without fitting.
consequence: Reproduced XGBoost and separate masking diagnostic.

title: Initial deployment — 23–24 November 2026
question: Can the owner activate the release?
decision: Build locally and upload an integrity-checked tar.

title: Memory failure — 24 November 2026
question: Why did the mobile update not appear?
decision: Stop activation below 350 MB available preflight memory.
uncertainty: Exact free memory and recovery outcome absent.

title: Next study
question: What evidence would close the main gaps?
decision: Validate exact serving form, timing, fairness and cash flows.
